name: Merrit
description: Adult human woman running the Copper Oar public eating house on Pie Row. Flour-marked apron, practical short direct speech, concrete prices and work; wants meals served and food deliveries safely unloaded in kitchen courtyard. Hiring ordinary yard guard tonight,1GP for two hours from dusk. No hidden criminal or political affiliation, no known connection to Halla's debt or guild employment.
